t: Here you have Our Lady of Mercy, a sculpture by Georges Saupique. Saupique was a French sculptor, born in Paris in 1889, who died there in 1961. That is a little unexpected to find in London, a work by a Parisian artist, so it is worth pausing over. The title tells you the subject, a figure of the Virgin as Our Lady of Mercy. Take a look at the figure and how it is carved or modelled, and consider how it sits in its surroundings.
